name: dao-anonymous-voting
description: Anonymous yes/no DAO voting: Noir circuit + Solidity contracts + client

scripts.circuit:build: cd circuits/vote && nargo compile && bb write_vk -b target/vote.json -o target/vk --verifier_target evm && bb write_solidity_verifier -k target/vk/vk -o ../../contracts/src/HonkVerifier.sol
scripts.deploy:local: cd contracts && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --broadcast --private-key 0xac0974bec39a17e36ba4a6b4d238ff944bacb478cbed5efcae784d7bf4f2ff80
